focal_region.annotated_sentence_text:
[Turn 1 USER]
e001	I direct a regional museum with a digitized collection of photographs, oral histories, and community records.
e002	An AI company has offered enough money to fund our preservation work for four years if it can train a cultural-search model on the archive.
e003	I want wider discovery and stable funding, but I am worried that licensing the collection turns stewardship into raw-material supply.
e004	I cannot tell whether my hesitation protects contributor trust or reflects an institutional instinct to control access.
[Turn 1 ASSISTANT]
e005	The offer combines preservation funding, public discovery, contributor permission, cultural context, model training, downstream reuse, and institutional control.
e006	Separate access to source records from the persistence of patterns learned from them.
e007	Also distinguish the museum's legal authority from the expectations of people whose lives are represented.
[Turn 7 USER]
e033	I am leaning toward the six-month metadata-and-reviewed-photograph pilot, excluding oral histories and sensitive records, with item provenance, search logs, no generated biographies, independent red-team review, and experimental-partner language.
e034	I will approve it only if the adapter is deleted at exit, retained engineering lessons cannot be used to reconstruct collection-specific associations, and renewal requires a new contributor review.
e035	I will set complaint, removal, false-association, and sensitive-query thresholds before signing.
e036	I have not resolved whether the museum can meaningfully promise contributors an exit when the company and researchers may still learn from the pilot.
[Turn 7 ASSISTANT]
e037	The current position is a bounded discovery experiment rather than a general archive-training license.
e038	Its scope, output, review, deletion, renewal, language, and threshold conditions constrain several forms of expansion.
e039	The unresolved issue is whether social and technical learning survives the formal exit even when data and the adapter are removed.
e040	If the pilot ends, engineering choices, researcher expectations, contributor trust, and the museum's public identity as an AI partner may not return to their prior state.

packet.question: How did the working position or decision change, and what qualification remains capable of changing it?
